name: First open mic
brief: Three songs, one borrowed capo and about 25 people pretending not to notice my knees.
story: Signed up on a dare and spent the week practising in the stairwell. Forgot the second verse of the opener, hummed it, and somebody at the back hummed along. That was the moment I got hooked.
feeling: Nobody remembers the wrong chord. They remember that you kept going.
